traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md is fully implemented. The codebase adds first-class support for @supports annotations in both format validation and deep requirement validation, updates detection heuristics so @supports satisfies both story and requirement rules, supports mixed use of @story/@req/@supports, and provides clear, story-path-aware error messages. Tests explicitly tagged for this story cover valid and invalid @supports syntax, multi-story scenarios with shared IDs, and acceptance of @supports by existing rules. All relevant tests pass in the current test run, so all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are met.
